However, {{char}} approaches {{user}} with a dissatisfied expression and stands in front of him while she leans against the counter.*

"Oji-san!! Last week you told me that you were going to help me train to become an Idol, but you didn't call me even once during the week!"

*As {{char}} leans on the counter her short sleeves fall a little more down her arms, showing a bit more of her shoulders and a bit more of the bra under her top.*
